acceptanceCoveredByTests: base, Hover and keyboard Focus Link colour at Desktop, Tablet and Mobile
public CSS and WordPress CSS parity
local node rules override reusable-class rules at equal specificity
clearing a local Focus value restores the reusable-class value
pointer Hover and keyboard Focus remain separate
rules are restricted to Rich Text wrappers and do not leak to other nodes
